title: Insurance Claim Services Credited-Line Write-Off and Reconstruction Change Order Credits
content:
**Rule.** For the Insurance Claim Services credited-line write-off, the change order credits are narrowed as follows: when the latest change order credit on the reconstruction contract was posted on or before the estimate submission date, none, because the estimate already left out the scope those signed deductive change orders removed; when it was posted after the estimate was submitted and an additive change order charge was posted on the contract on or after it, the change order credits less the additive change order charges taken net of the contract tier's change order markup (the charges divided by one plus that markup percentage), never below zero, because the insured put the removed scope's approved value toward the replacement scope, which the carrier funds up to that value; otherwise every change order credit posted on the contract, because the approved estimate carried the scope they removed outright.

Records read: the change order credits and the additive change order charges on the Reconstruction contract, with their posting dates, the change order markup percentage of the contract's tier, and the claim file's estimate submission date.

## Input — judgement — credits counted

| Latest change order credit posted | Additive change order charge posted on or after it | Credits counted |
|---|---|---|
| on or before the estimate submission date | any | none |
| after the estimate submission date | yes | credits less (additive charges divided by one plus the markup percentage), never below zero |
| after the estimate submission date | no | every change order credit posted on the contract |

## Hypothetical figures (markup 12 percent)

Change order credits of 2400.00, the latest posted after the estimate; an additive change order charge of 1792.00 posted later still. Charges net of markup: 1792.00 divided by 1.12 is 1600.00; credits counted 2400.00 less 1600.00, or 800.00. Had the additive charge been 3360.00, the net 3000.00 exceeds the credits and the count is 0.00.
